collection.title: Citroen C4 Aircross 2012 to 2017 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Citroen C4 Aircross 2012 - 2017 model requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 21" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. There is also the option to upgrade to the newer Retrofit type wiper blade. We also have the rear blade for this C4 Aircross, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.
